subject: Alphanumeric literals
notes: kb/Work PB929 sweep (2026-10-25): re-verdicted PARTIAL -> CONFORMS because the reason the row carried no longer reproduces on this tree. Rule: cite.py --check 8.3.3.2.4 "The implementor defines the result of specifying a hex-character-sequence-1 for which no corresponding character" -> OK 8.3.3.2.4 5). With two hex digits per alphanumeric character (SR6, HexGroupViolation) every group 00-FF maps to a character of the UTF-16 alphanumeric repertoire (DecodeHex images a group hh as U+00hh for 00-FE and FF as U+FFFF, the storage-byte law, kb/Work PB2919), so no 'no corresponding character' case arises; a character is 16 bits, a multiple of four, so the second sentence's mapping is not triggered. The definition is documented: docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-95 (CONFORMS; the earlier PARTIAL said Annex A.1 item 95 had no row). WITNESSES: l1c12_hex_alphanumeric_every_group (every group maps) and pb2919_hex_literal_ff_is_the_storage_byte (ORD(X"80FF0041") is 129 65536 1 66). Editions as adjudicated: 2014, 2023.
